scope.included: Grade 11 curriculum designs embedded by the official KICD Grade Eleven manifest
scope.excluded: Special-needs adaptations and documents not embedded by the official Grade Eleven manifest

manifest.title: Grade Eleven
manifest.heading: Grade 11 Designs
manifest.evidence: The official KICD WordPress page record identifies page 7661, parent page 7469, its published and modified values, eight ordered category headings, and 39 ordered Google Drive preview iframes in content.rendered.

catalogConventions.categoryMeaning: KICD landing-page category; no pathway assignment is inferred.
catalogConventions.officialFilenameMethod: Read from the public Google Drive preview og:title metadata for each iframe embedded by the official KICD page.
catalogConventions.documentDateCaveat: October 2025 is preserved as the document/filename date. It is not proof of final approval, publication status, or latest-revision status.

policies.canonicalSubject: The existing subject value is the catalog canonical subject.
policies.sourceLabel: kicdSourceLabel preserves the exact source-capture subject label joined by Drive file ID.
policies.alias: An alias is asserted only when the same Drive file ID proves that two producer labels identify the same embedded asset.
policies.unresolvedRelatedLabel: Related official labels without a shared Drive ID, official code, or explicit equivalence remain unresolved and must not be merged automatically.
policies.category: KICD landing-page category is preserved independently from pathway, track, and learning-area role.
policies.pathwayAndTrack: No single pathway or track is inferred from portal category for combination-dependent subjects. Null is an explicit unresolved or not-applicable value, not missing data.
policies.role: Core mathematics options, universal timetable/skills provisions, counted core learning areas, and selected learning areas are stored independently from category.

nonEquivalenceAssertions.evidence: The catalog contains separate Drive IDs for Computer Studies and ICT.
The catalog contains separate Drive IDs and titles.
Core and Essential Mathematics are separate embedded assets; Advanced Mathematics and generic Mathematics are external official labels whose equivalence is unresolved.

publicationStatusEvidence.observation: The sampled Agriculture cover is visibly watermarked DRAFT.
publicationStatusEvidence.scope: This observed DRAFT status applies only to the Agriculture document sampled.
publicationStatusEvidence.otherAssetFinality: Final or approved status is not established for the other 38 cataloged documents.
publicationStatusEvidence.dateCaveat: October 2025 in the filenames is not evidence of approval or final status.

coverageIssues.subject: Kenya Sign Language (KSL)

dimensions.pathwayTrackStatus: officially referenced missing design; no asset or placement synthesized

coverageIssues.evidence: KICD's November 2025 Senior School course-material submission document lists Kenya Sign Language among Grade 11 learning areas, but the official Grade Eleven curriculum-design manifest embeds no KSL design.
coverageIssues.caveat: This records a manifest coverage gap only; it does not prove that no KSL Grade 11 design exists elsewhere.
